annotations.title: Run a read-only Orderly CLI command

description: Run an allowed read-only Orderly CLI command with structured arguments. Use this instead of orderly_run for reads when your client asks for confirmation on destructive tools. Mutating commands are rejected. Prefer a dedicated read tool when one exists; call orderly_commands first for exact argument names and enums.

args.description: Structured arguments keyed by the names returned by orderly_commands. Put network here, or use the top-level network field.

command.description: Read-only CLI command name, e.g. "trades" or "funding-rates". Must appear in orderly_commands.

network.description: Network override for this call. Takes precedence over args.network. Defaults to ORDERLY_MCP_NETWORK, then the CLI config.

name: orderly_read
title: Run a read-only Orderly CLI command
